verdict.rationale: Chroma is Apache 2.0 and can be run locally or self-hosted at no cost, which lets a developer prototype before paying. Chroma Cloud also offers $5 of free credits to create a DB and try it out. A community user calls the pricing reasonable. Missing for 10: documented free-tier limits or quotas for Cloud, evidence that $5 of credits is enough for meaningful prototyping, and a recurring free tier rather than a one-off credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: Create a DB and try it out in under 30 seconds with $5 of free credits.
Chroma is licensed under Apache 2.0. Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.
